repairedFindings: Retain the same BaseException object for any quiesce failure, including operation entry and final deadline gates.
Commit whole-operation success only after the final gate; a later empty proof does not erase earlier cancel or stop failure.
Failed repetitions rethrow the original failure without another manager request or proof attempt; even successful repetitions remain deadline bounded.
Artifact removal remains rejected after a failed quiesce operation.
